inputs.text: [serious] Why am I telling you this? [pauses] Because it changes EVERYTHING for the dinosaurs! [curious] Take Cryolophosaurus: it lived in Antarctica during the Jurassic. [amazed] But guess what — back then, Antarctica wasn't icy and white like it is now. It was warm, with forests, because it was still part of Pangea, stuck to the rest of the world!
[curious] Antarctica, WARM? Not cold at all?
[confident] Not cold at all! [pauses] When the Earth changes shape, [curious] hot and cold change too. [happily] Cryolophosaurus lived happily in a warm Antarctica, with trees and sunshine!
